title: Showdown Challenges
intro: Every challenge meets the same learning outcomes, so adapt any of them or create your own. Students enjoy the food challenges most, and we're keen to learn how cooking shapes their experience; if your school allows it, try Decorate, Bake or Mystery.

rows.note: Print the cards and worksheets; gather paper and colouring supplies.
Buy cupcakes and frosting the day before; a craft version works if food isn’t possible.
Book the foods room and oven; one small batch per team makes 6 cupcakes.
Bake, plus one twist: a mystery mix-in or a teamwork twist.

items.text: A · Design, or B · Decorate as its craft version.
C · Bake, or D · Mystery to add a twist.
A · Design and B · Decorate fit one class; C and D take two.

blocks.title: Before any food challenge
blocks.text: Check your school’s food rules and every student’s allergies and dietary needs against each label, including cocoa and any mystery ingredient. The recipe has no eggs or dairy but contains wheat flour.
